name: Google Chat
description: Your Google Chat in lanes (Mentions, Direct messages, Spaces, Alerts, Recent) for a Google Workspace account, one account per project through your own OAuth client (the panel walks you through it). Mark read and unread; open a conversation as a page, annotate it and discuss it with Claude. Sorted by priority when Jev triage (bronos.jev-triage) is installed. Needs cc-cockpit 0.9.2 or later; 0.9.4 opens conversations at the newest message.
author: BronOS
